svg.text: Repository
Operate on a repository as a whole rather than on a file in it.
/git-gh-amplification-dtd [path to the repository, or leave blank for the current one; --verbose prints the evidence, --debug prints the commands]
34 laws
DTD-native: measure a repository's GitHub face (README, license, contributing,
templates, discussions, workflows, releases, funding, citation, changelog, badges), ask
up to thirty questions in eight rounds about what is missing, then write what was
chosen; git only, never gh
/repo-creativity-askingstorm-dtd [path to the repository, or leave blank for the current one; --verbose prints the evidence, --debug prints the commands]
35 laws
DTD-native: a storm of up to thirty questions in eight rounds about the creative face of
a repository (voice, tagline, logo, sigils, badges, gifs, screenshots, palette,
headings, emoji, sections, social preview, contents, callouts, footer, links), a
declared palette of hex swatches, then the writes
/repo-git-scalar-dtd [path to the repository, or leave blank for the current one; --verbose prints the evidence, --debug prints the commands]
34 laws
DTD-native: measure how a repository's git scales (ignore and attributes files, line
endings, LFS, hooks, branch model, tags, signing, trailers, worktrees, submodules,
sparse checkout, layout, remotes, default branch, history), ask up to thirty questions
in eight rounds, then write what was chosen
